sourceRules.subject: job-retry-policy
sourceRules.proposition: After a processor failure, automatic retry is eligible only when the next failed-attempt number remains below the configured attempts limit, the error is not unrecoverable, and the maximum-started-attempt limit has not been reached.
sourceRules.reasoning: The shouldRetryJob implementation checks attemptsMade + 1 < job attempts, rejects UnrecoverableError, and rejects when maxStartedAttempts is reached. The result is source-derived and has not been verified against a running BullMQ instance in this project.
limitations: Source code establishes the inspected implementation branch, not that a deployed system uses this exact build or configuration.

sourceRules.subject: job-retry-policy
sourceRules.proposition: When retry is eligible, the configured backoff result controls retry routing: -1 suppresses retry, a positive delay routes the job to delayed state, and zero or no delay routes it immediately back to waiting.
sourceRules.reasoning: The job implementation treats a backoff result of -1 as no retry, sends truthy positive delays through moveToDelayed, and otherwise calls retryJob. Backoffs.calculate passes a one-based failed-attempt number to the selected strategy. Runtime confirmation remains outstanding.
limitations: Custom strategy error/rejection behaviour and negative values other than -1 have not been established by this capture.
Source-derived evidence only; no runtime execution.
